title: Ring of Arcane Synergy

sources.title: Arcane Synergy
markers: Only applies on weapon attack rolls

summary: Deal damage with a cantrip to gain Arcane Synergy for 2 turns.

fields.Synergetic Cantrips: Deal cantrip damage to gain Arcane Synergy for 2 turns.
fields.Arcane Synergy: On weapon attack rolls, add your spellcasting ability modifier to damage in addition to the usual attack damage modifier. A melee spell attack such as Flame Blade does not qualify.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
